_instructions: Add this 'dasa_pada_text' type to DGE schemas.json. It is self-contained (does not disturb the mula/tika/tippani/itihasa_purana schemas). Each composition record in data/DvaitaVedanta/Itara/DasaSahitya/composers/<slug>.json validates against this shape.

dasa_pada_text.description: A single Haridasa composition (pada / suladi / ugabhoga / related song form) with Kannada text, auto-generated transliterations, and source attribution.

fields.form: enum — pada | suladi | ugabhoga | devaranama | aarati | mangala | kolu | shobhane | laali | dashavatara | sampradaya | kavya

title.latin: string — source romanized title (if the source gave one)

fields.deity: string — deity / subject (e.g. Krishna, Raghavendra Theertharu)
fields.tags: string[] — axis:value tags (composer:, deity:, on:, theme:)

text.source_roman: string[][] — romanization supplied by the source page, if any

fields.meaning: string — word-meaning / artha block if the source provides one
